thread:
asha: Quick heads-up: after yesterday's quantization bring-up on prod-candidate we see a ~6% jump in disagreement for the 'paraphrase' promptset, concentrated in short-form multi-turn prompts. Dumped disagreement metrics here: https://redwood.internal/metrics/quant/pars-paraphrase-disagree
mike: Yikes. Do we know if it's a quantization artifact or something else in the model? Any example IDs?
lina: Saw a handful. Example: `prompt_id=98321` before -> 'ok' vs after -> 'irrelevant answer' (short). I'll paste 3 samples in thread.
asha: Good point. I spot a pattern: responses that used to rely on long-context KV cache get truncated/changed. Hypothesis = quantization + attention pattern sensitivity. So treat as potential noise + true regressions.
prateek: I can run a dedupe + clustering pass. Proposed selection: disagreement>0.3 AND labeler_confidence<0.6, then fuzzy dedupe threshold 0.85 and keep earliest annotation dates.
asha: That sounds right. SQL we used earlier:
```
SELECT id, prompt, model, disagreement, labeler_confidence
FROM prompt_labels
WHERE promptset='paraphrase' AND disagreement>0.3 AND model LIKE 'prod-candidate%'
ORDER BY disagreement DESC
LIMIT 2000;
```
Use that as the seed for relabel batch.
lina: I'll do the fuzzy dedupe step (token-normalize -> edit-distance + embedding-sim). Plan: run exact-match dedupe first, then faiss cosine similarity with threshold 0.85, dedupe clusters >1 keep representative with highest disagreement.
labeling-bot: Batch created: LB-9876 (1,950 items) — relabel-quant-noise-2026-03. Golden quota requested: 200 items. Link: https://redwood.internal/labeling/batches/LB-9876
mike: I'll own QC for the golden 200. ETA: EOD Thu (will flag any ambiguous ones back to eng-ml).
emma: Heads-up labeler capacity: we can do ~2k relabels over 48 hours if we prioritize. Need final guideline snippet for edge-cases (intent vs phrasing).
asha: Draft guideline (short):
- If intent matches user ask -> prefer 'on-topic'.
- If model hallucinated external facts -> label 'incorrect_fact'.
- If response is fluent but misses ask -> 'partial'.
- Mark 'uncertain' only when annotator can't decide after 2 attempts.
- When in doubt, add short justification in comment field.
lina: For dedupe: I'm going to store cluster_id in `dedupe_clusters` table and append cluster_size to batch metadata.
prateek: Also will run the eval-harness backfill: add `relabel_batch=LB-9876` to the eval job payload. After relabel we run `quant-noise-retest` job.
asha: Timeline proposal: dedupe pass today (lina), relabeling Wed-Thu, golden QC by mike Thu EOD, eval run Fri 09:00 PT. If failure signals persist we'll rollback model and open a postmortem.
mike: ack :thumbsup:
lina: started dedupe now — ETA 3 hours.
prateek: kicking off backfill scripts after dedupe finishes.
labeling-bot: Reminder: LB-9876 assigned to 8 labelers. Progress: 0/1950 done (just created)
emma: I'll coordinate labeler rotations and make sure golden 200 are distributed to senior labelers.
asha: Thanks all. I'll compile notes into the ticket and tag `#incidents` if we hit >5% system-level regression. Keep updates here.
mike: ping @lina if you hit anything weird on dedupe thresholds.
lina: will do.
